primary_sources.title: Verified Tool Calls Improve LLM Agent Reliability Under Non-Atomic Failures

evidence.ablation_scope: Separate ablation, activate_customer only, medium fault level.
cells_present: verification OFF / tool retry ON: retry-only baseline
verification ON / tool retry OFF after ambiguous failure: verification-only
verification ON / tool retry ON conditionally: verify-before-retry

reported_ablation_rates.retry_only: about 58% task success; about 42% duplicate actions
reported_ablation_rates.verification_only: about 80% task success; about 20% duplicate actions
reported_ablation_rates.verify_before_retry: about 72% task success; about 28% duplicate actions

findings.scope_guard: This is a three-cell partial interaction in one simulated task at medium fault, not a complete 2x2 verification-by-recovery factorial and not a production-API result.

evidence.agent_visible_tool_retry: Paper caps tool-call retry budget at N=1 per logical operation; verify-before-retry gates that retry on postcondition FALSE.
evidence.llm_client_retry: Rate-limited LLM responses are retried up to five times inside the client.
evidence.tool_environment: Controlled simulated environment; not live production APIs.

unverified_loci: gateway/provider tool-effect retry beyond the described simulator
findings.scope_guard: The five-attempt client retry is an LLM-request retry locus, not evidence of five tool-effect retries. It nevertheless means a nominal recovery-off experimental condition is not globally retry-free unless retry is defined narrowly to tool effects.

findings.reason: The evaluated agent depends on an externally hosted Gemini Flash-Lite model interface, and the primary paper does not establish operation when external API/model monthly/trial/paid quotas are zero. The experiment also retains a separate LLM-client retry locus. Therefore it is useful evidence about verification/retry semantics but not proof of a zero-external-quota scheduled-Chat replacement route.
do_not_infer: Do not treat the three ablation arms as a complete 2x2 factorial.
Do not call verification-only globally no-retry without qualifying the separate LLM-client rate-limit retries.
Do not generalize simulator results to production provider semantics.
Do not count the hosted Gemini-backed experiment as zero-optional-quota Phase-1 acceptance evidence.

overall_assessment: The long_horizon reading is source-faithful. The paper supplies exactly three verification/tool-retry ablation arms and omits the OFF/OFF cell; verification-only outperforms retry-only in its separate medium-fault ablation, while the combined arm is not monotone on the reported outcomes. The implementation separately retries rate-limited LLM responses up to five times. For Phase 1 this remains design evidence, not an accepted dependency-elimination route, because the demonstrated path uses a hosted Gemini model interface and does not prove operation with optional external model/API quotas at zero.
continuation: Next invocation fresh-bootstrap current authority, then audit exactly one next high-relevance C32 primary-source row not already covered. Prefer a candidate whose claimed route could remove rather than merely characterize an external-model/provider dependency; enumerate residual executor, every retry locus, every finite monthly/trial/paid quota, and incremental cost. Do not start that second leaf in this invocation.
